startup.name: Savant
startup.one_liner: Company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on
startup.description: Savant connects to the tools a company already uses, captures written knowledge and undocumented procedures, and serves them to employees and AI agents at decision time. Seven person team in San Francisco, Spring 2026 batch. The buyer is an enterprise or scaleup that wants its agents to act on company context, probably paid per seat or by usage.

yc_acceptance.basis: Starting prior is about 1 percent for a random applicant (0.6 to 2 percent, references/yc_acceptance.md). Up for a company brain pitch that matches the 2026 AI agent theme and a team of seven, which implies technical founders and some build capacity. Down because the company brain space is crowded with funded rivals and nothing in the input shows customers or revenue. Net about 3 percent, and the company is already in the batch so this is for completeness.
yc_acceptance.why_it_fails: YC would most likely say that company brain and enterprise memory products are a crowded category where Glean, Notion and the model labs already ship connectors and agent memory, and that a seven person team has not shown a customer who pays. Partners may also doubt that a horizontal knowledge layer can win a first wedge.

Narrow cohort python3 -I scripts/base_rates.py --tag AI --calibration-only: seed cond 64% (n=183), series_a cond 30% (n=117), series_b cond 31% (n=35), series_c cond 45% (n=11). Time table era 2022+: seed median 8 months from batch start, p25 4, p75 20 (AI tag); series_a median 28 months.
anchors.adjustment_reason: Window is 7.4 months, from 2026-04-06 to 2026-11-17, and counts only a round above about 1M from outside investors that closes inside it. The anchor 0.59 is for reaching seed ever. For 2022 and later B2B companies about half of eventual seeds close by month 8 (median 8, p25 4), so 0.59 times roughly 0.6 gives 0.35, which is 0.6x of the anchor. Hot agent context sector and team of seven are not lifted above the anchor, per the winners test. These odds do not rank this company against others.

bands.rationale: Small post YC round under 3M, an angel or small fund round after the demo day period.
Institutional seed near the 2022 and later median of 3.5M to 4.1M (round_benchmarks.csv, stage_benchmarks.md).
Strong seed for an AI native company in a hot category with early enterprise logos, near the 6M to 10M quartile of recent press covered rounds.
Large seed from a top fund after fast enterprise pilots; rare for seven people and a 7 month window.

ladder.why_it_fails: The seed step inside 7.4 months fails if the company has pilots but no paid contract by the end of the batch, because investors in this category want revenue or a named enterprise design partner. Slite reached a seed only because it won a narrow team wiki base by word of mouth, Station (a team knowledge base) shut down, and Opzi (business Q&A) never recovered after its angel round. Several well funded rivals take the same investor attention.

outcomes.why_it_fails: Most likely the company stalls or pivots after a seed, because company brain products are easy to copy by platform vendors and enterprise sales cycles are slow. Slite shows that a knowledge tool can survive but stay mid sized; Station and Opzi show how fast cheap copies or incumbents can kill the idea.

killers.risk: Platform vendors (Glean, Notion, Microsoft, Atlassian) ship the same connector and agent memory layer
killers.evidence: Glean, Notion AI and Microsoft Copilot already index workplace tools, and several 2026 startups raised seed money for the same context layer idea.
killers.mitigation: Pick a narrow wedge such as undocumented procedures in one function and prove a measurable agent accuracy gain.

killers.risk: Pilots do not convert to paid contracts because enterprise security reviews and data access slow deals
killers.evidence: Tools that read all company documents need security approval, and the product must work across many systems before showing value.
killers.mitigation: Start with mid market buyers with fewer reviews and ship a self hosted or read only mode.

killers.risk: Seed investors see a crowded context layer category and pass or demand revenue first
killers.evidence: Early 2026 rounds in this category were seed sized at 3M to 16M for teams with more traction, and many had pre-seed rounds of 2.7M, so the bar is real.
killers.mitigation: Show a named customer with agents using Savant in production before demo day.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connectors to many tools and permission aware retrieval are tedious but known engineering, and a seven person team can ship a first version in three months. The hard part is extracting undocumented procedures with accuracy that agents can trust and keeping permissions correct across systems.

takeover_risk.rationale: Incumbents already own the connectors and the user base, and adding agent context is a natural feature for them. A well resourced rival could match a first version in under a year; the defense is depth in procedure capture and neutrality across vendors.

evidence.claim: Several seed rounds of 3M to 16M in early 2026 for enterprise context layers show investor and buyer interest
Pre-seed funding for a context layer for AI in February 2026 shows the category is forming

strengths: Short, easy to say and spell

Does not hint at company memory
brand.rationale: A real word with a clear meaning of a knowledgeable person fits a knowledge product, similar to short real word names like Notion and Slite, but it is not ownable and will not drive growth. Neutral for the ladder.

narrative.headline: A well timed company brain bet in a crowded field; seed inside 7 months is roughly a one in three event.
narrative.general_summary: Savant sells an enterprise knowledge layer for people and agents, a category that attracted many seed rounds in early 2026 and also many YC peers and platform rivals. The cohort anchors say about 59 percent of 2022 and later B2B YC companies reach a seed ever, but only about half of those close by month 8, so a 7.4 month window gives about 35 percent. Later rounds are nearly impossible inside the window. Analogs such as Slite, Station and Opzi show the ceiling and the failure modes of knowledge tools. The odds do not rank this company against others.

assumptions: The input has no traction data; seed odds assume a normal Spring 2026 company with a working product.
Window 7.4 months; seed means a round above about 1M from outside investors that closes inside it.
Coverage of funding in the data is incomplete (base rate range is shown); Spring 2026 peers were not used as analogs.
